args.body: Hello Ronan, the smoke alarm at 26 Tallowmere Close has still not been refitted (reported 7 August). The tenant says a fitter attended, removed the bracket and could not refit it as the box had no bracket. We have had no contractor name or completion date from you since your email of 12 August. Please reply by Wednesday 24 September with: 1) the name of your electrician/fitter and whether they have attended, 2) a firm date to fit a working alarm (the property has no working alarm in the meantime, so this is a safety matter; a temporary battery alarm would be a sensible stop-gap). 3) Did anyone you arranged call at the property unannounced on Saturday 20 September? The tenant did not let them in as they could not verify who it was. Please ensure any visitor gives the tenant 24 hours' written notice via us. The tenant has been unwell, so please let us arrange access with them. Until we hear from you we are treating this as your own-contractor job and will not send ours, to avoid the work being done twice.

args.body: Hello Elise, I hope you're recovering well. One short note on the smoke alarm, no reply needed unless you want to. You were right not to let in the unannounced visitor: nobody should enter without 24 hours' written notice from us, and we have not verified who it was. We have asked your landlord whether it was their fitter and for a firm date to refit the alarm; the landlord is arranging this with their own electrician. As the alarm is down, a cheap battery smoke alarm placed nearby would help in the meantime. If you feel unsafe, call 999. We will update you by Thursday 25 September, and we won't contact you otherwise unless needed.
